top_offers.title: VP of Engineering (Remote)
top_offers.why: Owns the full migration from legacy stack to an AI-native data pipeline — exactly the kind of platform-zero-to-one challenge Magino drove at Alaya and continued post-acquisition at Benevity. The role explicitly calls for building AI-assisted engineering infrastructure (code generation, agent-based tooling, org-wide AI productivity), which mirrors Magino's current focus. Fully remote, VP level, scale-up with real platform complexity.

top_offers.title: VP/Head of Engineering — Identity, Access & User Management
top_offers.why: VP/Head of Engineering for mission-critical IAM/backend teams at a large streaming platform — right seniority level, meaningful scope, and a distributed systems challenge. Amsterdam is in European timezone range from Geneva. Stack leans backend cloud architecture rather than TypeScript/Node, and DAZN is enterprise-scale rather than startup, so company fit is partial.

top_offers.title: Technical Lead — Full Stack Engineering
top_offers.why: TypeScript, Node.js, React stack is a near-perfect match and the role is fully remote. Sprinto is a compliance automation scale-up (Series B, $31.8M, 350+ people, 2500+ customers) which maps to Magino's experience with SaaS platform evolution. The 'Technical Lead' title is slightly below Staff+, and the company is India-headquartered which may imply IST-leaning collaboration hours.

top_offers.title: Staff Product Engineer
top_offers.why: Staff-level, fully remote, and the role is explicitly AI-native: most code is authored by AI agents, and the job is about making those agents ship at staff-level quality — prompts, evals, observability. That framing resonates with Magino's AI-augmented engineering practice. Compensation ($80–100k USD) is below Geneva market rates, and the hiring focus skews toward Latin American timezones.

top_offers.title: Senior AI Research Engineer
top_offers.why: Lausanne is 50 minutes from Geneva, hybrid model, and the role involves LLMs, agents, and applied AI systems — terrain Magino knows well. Nexthink is a mature B2B SaaS (~2000 people) rather than a startup, and 'Senior' is a step below Staff+. Solid Switzerland option if proximity matters more than startup ownership.

top_offers.title: VP of Engineering

Paris is only 3 hours from Geneva by train, but the role explicitly requires 2 days/week in office, making it a relocation or commute decision. Stack is general web platform rather than TypeScript/AI-first.

Berlin-based with no clear remote option, which is the main friction from Geneva.
